title: Workflow Handoff Expansion Foundation
goal: Extend the Jira-first integration foundation into a generic, controlled workflow-handoff pattern without creating a shadow runtime lane.
scope: Add the next enterprise workflow slice by defining and implementing one generic outbound handoff pattern, such as webhook or GitHub issue handoff, using the existing integration configuration/linking style. Keep automatic background synchronization, broad marketplace installation, and uncontrolled plugin behavior out of scope.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add exactly one controlled handoff pattern. Do not bundle Slack, Teams, ServiceNow, GitHub, webhooks, and bidirectional sync into one task.
notes: Reuse the existing integration configuration and finding-link concepts where possible.
Any external action must be explicit, operator-triggered, and auditable.

success_criteria: One additional workflow handoff pattern is implemented or fully specified as the next controlled integration slice.
Finding linkage and sync state remain additive and separate from canonical finding fields.
Operator-triggered handoff is auditable and failure-aware.
Docs clearly state what integrations remain future work.
No background sync worker or uncontrolled plugin installation is introduced.
must_not_touch: pack registry and runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: The handoff is operator-triggered and auditable.
Failure state is visible and stored without corrupting finding records.
Only one integration expansion is included in this slice.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The selected integration handoff target is explicitly named before implementation starts.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with integration handoff changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new integration baseline and remaining integration gaps.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: ServiceNow plus Slack plus Teams in the same slice
